caption:
AI sounds sure. That doesn't mean it's right.

Chatbots can invent a study and insist it's real. Merc does the opposite. He asks how you'd check, then lets you work it out.

Has an AI ever confidently told you something wrong?
captionNote: Ad 1 caption with its XP/ranks sentence deleted (the hero cut does not show XP or ranks); nothing else changed.
transcript: "AI sounds sure. That doesn't mean it's right. Can you tell the difference?"
Most AI chatbots. Student: "Is this source real?" Chatbot: "Yes! It's a real study." Stamp: "Confidently wrong."
Merc, your Mercurius tutor. Student: "Is this source real?" Merc: "Good instinct. How could you check?" Student: "Search for the study itself?" Merc: "Exactly. So why would an AI invent one?"
End card: Merc. "Mercurius. Learn how AI really works." Download on the App Store. Search "Mercurius AI" on iPhone.
